# `ferroterm`

**Audience:** operators. Every command and option of the
`ferroterm` server, as `ferroterm <command> --help` prints it. With no command it
serves. [Configuration](../operate/configuration.md) describes the configuration
every command reads.

<!-- toc -->

## `ferroterm`

```text
The `ferroterm` command line.

Serving is the default so the image's exec-form entrypoint keeps working with no arguments; a subcommand is something the container runs beside it.

Usage: ferroterm [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  serve        Serves until the process is asked to stop
  config       Works on the configuration
  healthcheck  Asks the server running beside this process whether it is ready, and exits 0 only when it is
  help         Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --config <PATH>
          The TOML configuration file; unset, the product's `_CONFIG` variable names it

      --set <KEY=VALUE>
          One configuration key set over the file and the environment, as `key=value`; repeatable

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

  -V, --version
          Print version
```

## `ferroterm config`

```text
Works on the configuration

Usage: ferroterm config [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  check  Reads the configuration, reports every refusal with its key, and prints the running tree with every secret redacted
  help   Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --config <PATH>
          The TOML configuration file; unset, the product's `_CONFIG` variable names it

      --set <KEY=VALUE>
          One configuration key set over the file and the environment, as `key=value`; repeatable

  -h, --help
          Print help
```
